findings.summary: Requirement R5 mandates a stage_handoff at every stage transition, but because the plan defines multiple, conflicting stage models (linear stages, per-lane sub-stages, and integration stages), “every stage transition” is ambiguous (global vs per-lane vs integration). This is a semantic mismatch that affects acceptance testing and validator logic.

evidence.quote: Compile deterministic context packs for each stage from workspace_index and declared selection rules (CNS8).

evidence.note: C22 also claims checkpoint/restore operations
evidence.quote: Support per-lane and global checkpoint/restore; enforce retention/compaction policies.

findings.summary: Requirement R13 mandates diff-only patchsets as the sole code change mechanism, but Risk K12 mitigation references 'automated conflict resolution' without specifying how this is achieved using only diff-only patchsets, creating a potential bypass of the repair model constraint.
